proof_body:
by
  intro F f S hF hu
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have hε3 : 0 < ε / 3 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 hu (ε / 3) hε3)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.1 (hF N) (ε / 3) hε3
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_⟩
  have a := hN N le_rfl x hx
  have b := hN N le_rfl y hy
  have c := h x hx y hy hxy
  rw [dist_comm] at b
  have t := dist_triangle4 (f x) (F N x) (F N y) (f y)
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ), (∀ n, UniformContinuousOn (F n) S) → TendstoUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop S → UniformContinuousOn f S
